subject.cedVersion: AP Environmental Science CED (Course at a Glance, 9 units, 99 topics; 2027 exam: fully digital, 80 MC/90 min, 3 FRQ/70 min; 2026-27 clarifications only, no content change)
subject.designNotes: 9 units with unit weights from the AP Central course page and topic codes/titles/class periods from the Course at a Glance PDF (that PDF is the 2019-printed layout; AP Central states course content is unchanged for 2026-27). Exam page (read 2026-10-20): fully digital in Bluebook; Section I 80 MC, 90 min, 60% (individual questions plus 3-5 quantitative sets, 3-5 qualitative sets, 2 text-based sets); Section II 3 FRQ, 70 min, 40% (Q1 design an investigation, Q2 analyze data, Q3 analyze an environmental problem with calculations); calculators permitted. FRQ point values are not stated on the exam page and were not verified here (historically 10 each). Skills are the 7 science practices at practice level (the CED's per-practice skill codes were not extracted); no skill weights recorded. The full CED PDF exceeded the fetch limit. Per-topic and per-sub-keyword skills are an ALTON editorial mapping (one skill per sub-keyword chosen by kind and content), not the CED's per-topic suggested skills. Sub-keywords, kinds, requires and estLessons are ALTON editorial designs, not CED content. Topic titles are the CED's where read from the CED course-at-a-glance; where the extracted text was truncated they are close paraphrases.
